- ADR-0087's at-rest supersession (2026-09-13 addendum) reads: "Metadata at rest has no author to teach, so it replays the full chain, retired entries included — … and a compiled artifact inside the versioned window its own manifest opens". A `^18` artifact that fails to boot because a retired entry is not replayed inside its window is a refusal that accepted text negates. Fixing it is `no`.
Responsibility: the window arithmetic is `metadata-core`'s (`artifact-forward-conversion.ts`) · #20390 (PR #20435) covers a 17.x floor only, and nothing covers a floor that is the prerelease major · every `^18` artifact built before a prerelease retirement reaches it. #22990's two keys make it acute: #22876 and PR #22990 are parked on #22994 and this card.
